headline.title: How GPT-5 helped immunologist Derya Unutmaz solve a 3-year-old mystery
headline.summary: Immunologist Derya Unutmaz utilized GPT-5 Pro to gain insights into T cell behavior, helping to resolve a three-year-old mystery in immunology. This advancement may have implications for cancer and autoimmune research.

articles.title: Oracle’s 21,000 layoffs help drive its debt-fueled AI investments
articles.summary: Oracle has announced 21,000 layoffs as part of a strategy to fund its significant investments in data center infrastructure aimed at enhancing its AI capabilities. The company's focus on AI is supported by a substantial increase in debt to finance these initiatives.

articles.title: Why corporate AI super PACs spent $27 million on a local election
articles.summary: Corporate AI super PACs invested $27 million in a local election to influence policy decisions affecting the industry. This spending highlights the growing intersection of technology and politics as companies seek to shape regulatory environments.

articles.title: Introducing Mistral OCR 4
articles.summary: Mistral OCR 4 has been launched, offering enterprise-level document AI capabilities with support for 170 languages, bounding box functionality, and options for self-hosted deployment. This new version aims to enhance document processing efficiency for businesses.

articles.title: 4 days left to save up to $190 on TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
articles.summary: Early Bird registration for the TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 ends on June 26 at 11:59 p.m. PT, offering discounts of up to $190 on passes. Interested participants are encouraged to register within the next four days to take advantage of the savings.

articles.title: The $400 million machine powering the future of chipmaking
articles.summary: A new $400 million machine, designed by Jos Benschop, is set to revolutionize chipmaking with its advanced capabilities and massive scale. The machine, weighing over 150 tons and featuring intricate engineering, represents a significant investment in the future of semiconductor manufacturing.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude Tag is learning your company, one Slack message at a time
articles.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Tag, an AI feature for Slack that serves as an always-on teammate to enhance productivity. This tool aims to capture organizational context, institutional knowledge, and streamline enterprise workflows.

articles.title: Fika Jobs raises $4M to build a video-first hiring platform where AI agents interview candidates
articles.summary: Stockholm-based startup Fika Jobs has raised $4 million to develop a video-first hiring platform that integrates AI interview agents with short-form video profiles. The platform aims to enhance the recruitment process by combining elements of LinkedIn and TikTok.

articles.title: Something’s off with Midjourney’s pivot to body scanners
articles.summary: Midjourney has announced a shift from its image generation focus to developing a futuristic ultrasound scanner that immerses users in water to produce medical imaging results comparable to MRI technology. The company aims to make medical imaging more accessible and casual, likening the experience to a spa visit.

articles.title: Helping build shared standards for advanced AI
articles.summary: OpenAI is collaborating with the Appia Foundation to establish shared standards for advanced AI, focusing on evaluation frameworks and safety practices. This initiative aims to promote global cooperation in the development and deployment of AI technologies.

articles.title: Sony’s AI Camera Assistant is exactly as bad as it looks
articles.summary: Sony's new AI Camera Assistant for the Xperia 1 VIII has received criticism for producing subpar photos, with early samples showcasing significant quality issues. Despite the company's promotional efforts, user experiences indicate that the AI's performance falls short of expectations.

articles.title: Meta launches cheaper smart glasses without Ray-Ban
articles.summary: Meta has introduced a new line of smart glasses that do not feature the Ray-Ban branding, marking a shift in their product strategy. The new glasses come in three styles and seven colors, expanding Meta's offerings in the wearable technology market.
